<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex45012023-03-0112-52-17" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed">
            dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">chos kyi seng ge</rs> na re byas pa'i tha snyad byas pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la rgyu rkyen las skyes pa mtshan nyid du bkod pa de mtshon 'dod med nas mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la <lb edRef="inst:4770" n="16a3"/> mi srid pa yin ste | mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya tha dad med pa'i phyir ro zhe na |
            ba lang gi tha snyad tshad mas grub pa'i tshe nog shal lasogs 'dus pa de ba lang gi tha snyad la ltos te mtshan nyid skyon myed po ma yin par thal | <lb edRef="inst:5593" n="13a5"/> mtshon 'dod med pa'i phyir ro ||
            rtags tshad ma | khyab pa med na mtshon 'dod med pa mtshan nyid kyi skyon <lb edRef="inst:4770" n="16a4"/> yin pa nyams so ||</seg></TEI>
